content.markdown:
Every Entry file MUST contain an object envelope with `format: "snl-entry"`, storage `version: 1`, string owner `package`, and an object `entry`. `entry.id` MUST be a non-empty whitespace-canonical string; `entry.package` MUST be a string equal to the envelope owner. The deterministic filename MUST match owner Package plus Entry ID. Entry IDs MUST be globally unique across the complete pool.

The payload MUST have non-empty string `kind`; `title` MUST be a string or valid I18N string; `content` MUST be an object; and `pointer` MUST be present. `content.snl`, when present, MUST be a string. `typst`, `latex`, `markdown`, and `text`, when present, MUST be strings or valid I18N strings.

An absent Entry `schema_version` is currently accepted and normalized in memory to `1`; a present marker MUST be the positive supported value `1`. This differs from a writer that requires the marker on disk.

## Entry tags (additive optional field)

Entry supports own optional `tags: string[]`. Absence means no tags; a present value MUST be an array consisting only of strings (`null`, scalar and mixed arrays are invalid). Identity is exact, case-sensitive string equality; do not split, trim, case-fold or infer tags from title, Kind, Macro or Style. Preserve authored order and values, including punctuation and prototype-like strings such as `__proto__`; duplicate values have no additional membership meaning. No tag registry, per-tag entity, implicit inheritance or batch rewrite is introduced. Existing absent-tag records remain valid and are not eagerly rewritten.

Creation, editing, copy/rename/move and unrelated Entry saves in Extension and Toolkit must preserve valid tags; explicit `[]` clears them. An update input omitting tags preserves current tags, not implicit deletion. Ordinary authored tag changes use existing revision/CAS safeguards. Present malformed tags are rejected before publishing data. This is an optional payload extension under the existing envelope/version; it does not change storage topology or claim a migration ran. Old software that discards this field on save must be upgraded before editing tagged entries.

Entry editor exposes editable tag rows with add/remove controls; raw string identity is retained. Host/wire/HTML Entry projections preserve the field. Graph payload uses only canonical Entry tags, exposing `tags?: string[]` with absence as empty. Tag→color configuration is preview state, NOT Entry data.
